title: Hierarchical time series with persephone3
text: creating perHts object, can pass specification parameters applied aggregate series. iterate = TRUE (default), parameters also applied components recursively: automdl.enabled = FALSE setting applied aggregate series components (b). can verify inspecting specifications: modify individual components creation, access directly:
code: # Create hierarchical object with custom parameters applied to all nodes hts_custom <- perHts(   a = perX13(AirPassengers),   b = perTramo(AirPassengers),   template = "rsa1",   automdl.enabled = FALSE )  hts_custom$run() hts_custom #>  component run  method     type      seasonality logTransform #>            TRUE tramoseats aggregate Present     TRUE         #>  a         TRUE x13        single    Present     TRUE         #>  b         TRUE tramoseats single    Present     TRUE         #>  arimaMdl       nOutliers Q    Q2   TotalQ #>  (0 1 1)(0 1 1) NA          NA   NA Good   #>  (0 1 1)(0 1 1) NA        0.26 0.29 Good   #>  (0 1 1)(0 1 1) NA          NA   NA Good # Check aggregate spec hts_custom$paramsDirect$automdl.enabled #> NULL  # Check component a spec hts_custom$components$a$paramsDirect$automdl.enabled #> NULL  # Check component b spec hts_custom$components$b$paramsDirect$automdl.enabled #> NULL # Re-enable automdl for component a only hts_custom$components$a$updateParams(automdl.enabled = TRUE) hts_custom$components$a$paramsDirect$automdl.enabled #> NULL

title: Hierarchical time series - construction and weights
text: weights parameter set numeric vector length equal number components. Almost call, weights, one component. additional aggregation steps, weight automatically summed . e.g. weight central europe 12, sum 12 times 1.
code: hts_see <- perHts(list = ts_28[south_eastern_europe], weights=c(1,2,3,4)) hts_ne <- perHts(list = ts_28[northern_europe], weights = c(5,6,7,8)) # 4 countries: Denmark, Finland, Sweden, Ireland hts_ce <- perHts(list = ts_28[central_europe], weights = rep(1,12)) hts_se <- perHts(list = ts_28[southern_europe], weights = c(8,9,10,10.5)) hts_we <- perHts(list = ts_28[western_europe], weights = c(11,12)) # 2 countries: France, Netherlands hts_np <- perHts(northern_europe = hts_ne,                  western_europe = hts_we,                  central_europe = hts_ce ) hts_sp <- perHts(southern_europe = hts_se,                  south_eastern_europe = hts_see ) knitr::kable(head(hts_np$weights)) ht_europe <- perHts(north_part = hts_np,                  south_part = hts_sp )  knitr::kable(head(ht_europe$weights))

title: Hierarchical time series - construction and weights
text: many scenarios weights fixed time, change, e.g. turnover used aggregate certain production index. scenarios weights can provided lists time series mts object. starting weights equal 1 change weight Germany time. can now call perHts function mts input. can proceed .
code: # Convert list to mts (multi-time series) object weights_eu <- do.call(cbind, Exports[eu_countries]) * 0 + 1 weights_eu[is.na(weights_eu)] <- 1 weights_eu[,"Germany"] <- weights_eu[,"Germany"] + rlnorm(nrow(weights_eu)) hts_see <- perHts(list = ts_28[south_eastern_europe],                    weights=weights_eu[,south_eastern_europe]) hts_ne <- perHts(list = ts_28[northern_europe],                   weights=weights_eu[,northern_europe]) hts_ce <- perHts(list = ts_28[central_europe],                   weights=weights_eu[,central_europe]) hts_se <- perHts(list = ts_28[southern_europe],                   weights=weights_eu[,southern_europe]) hts_we <- perHts(list = ts_28[western_europe],                   weights=weights_eu[,western_europe]) hts_np <- perHts(northern_europe = hts_ne,                  western_europe = hts_we,                  central_europe = hts_ce ) hts_sp <- perHts(southern_europe = hts_se,                  south_eastern_europe = hts_see ) knitr::kable(head(hts_np$weights)) ht_europe <- perHts(north_part = hts_np,                  south_part = hts_sp )  knitr::kable(head(ht_europe$weights))
